About Us

UNIGENS is a Romanian software development company, activating in the gambling industry, offering integrated management solutions for companies in the field (B2B). Our company operates with a Class-II type license issued by ONJN more than 10 years ago and our clients are both local (Romania) as well as international. The 360 R/Evolution Platform is the main product UNIGENS is developing. It includes a wide array of features and applications which cover the entire spectrum of activities that a gambling operator requires.


YOU will experience our working environment where you will have:
- Ability to learn new things
- Interaction with young and enthusiastic team
- Working in cool, interesting and international projects
- Professional challenges
- Overall personal development
- to work on-prem (mainly) and remote (optional), full time

and expect 15.000 RON Brut, during 3 month probation period


For all these, YOU, as an experienced Back End developer, will have to:
- Integrate user oriented elements developed by front-end developer;
- Build code reusable for future requests;
- Optimize to full speed and scalability of applications;
- Implement security and data protection elements;
- Implement solutions to store data;


YOUR Technical Expertise, as an experienced Back End developer, on:
- Understanding of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, Jquery, Javascript)
- CMS or/and MVC frameworks (Codeigniter, Wordpress);
- PHP OOP;
- MySQL and nonSQL databases (MongoDB is a plus);
- computer architecture and backend ecosystem;
- Test driven development
- Medium/Advanced English skills
is critical for the beginning of our cooperation


YOUR application will be much appreciated if you have:
- Good communications / inter-personal skills
- Analytical and critical thinking skills
- Relevant previous experience
- Desire to learn new technologies
- Open-minded approach

Looking forward to hearing from you,

Have an amazing day!
